data.title: Olympic-bound queens roar home
data.description: Thailand's history-making volleyball queens touched down to a hero's welcome at Suvarnabhumi on Monday night, mobbed by fans still buzzing from Sunday's Olympic-qualifying triumph over China.

data.title: Srisaket keeps going, but Jaro fight shows sport's ruthless side
data.description: <p>I remember standing in a Bangkok gym in 2017 while a group of fighters discussed Srisaket Sor Rungvisai's upcoming world title fight against Roman "Chocolatito" Gonzalez at Madison Square Garden.</p>

data.title: Thais open U20 campaign with UAE win
data.description: Thailand's U20 side made a winning start to their AFC U20 Asian Cup Uzbekistan 2027 qualifying campaign, edging past the United Arab Emirates 1-0 at Chonburi Stadium on Monday night.

data.title: Diggers 'damaging ancient burial sites'
data.description: <p>PHETCHABUN: Authorities have found more than 200 pits at an archaeological site in Wichian Buri district, where illegal digging appears to have disturbed prehistoric graves and scattered human and animal remains.</p>

data.title: Satun gets 30 days to study seaplane base
data.description: <p>SATUN: The Transport Ministry has given Satun authorities 30 days to report on the feasibility of a state-run seaplane landing facility to serve Koh Lipe and other Andaman destinations.</p>

data.title: 'Vessel collision' kills whale
data.description: <p>A post-mortem examination has found that a Bryde's whale that washed ashore in Samut Prakan died from severe injuries to its head and upper jaw, believed to have been caused by a collision with a vessel, the Department of Marine and Coastal Resources said.</p>

data.title: Grey capital crackdown widens beyond Bangkok
data.description: <p>Authorities are intensifying a crackdown on suspected nominee businesses and "grey capital", with about 14,000 companies nationwide under further investigation, Deputy Interior Minister Polapee Suwunchwee said.</p>

data.title: Youth hit hard as total HIV cases exceed 500,000
data.description: <p>Thailand has recorded more than 500,000 cumulative HIV infections, with 13 provinces reporting more than 10,000 cases each, according to fiscal 2026 data.</p>

data.title: Platform workers want better deal
data.description: <p>Platform riders are pressing for stronger legal protection, including fairer pay, basic insurance and greater transparency in algorithmic decisions, as lawmakers and labour groups seek to establish new standards for the rapidly expanding sector.</p>

data.title: Govt to face twin debates
data.description: <p>The opposition is set to submit both a general debate and a no-confidence motion against the government, despite it having been in office for only five months, citing mounting problems in several areas, according to an opposition whip.</p>

data.title: Food hub dream in trouble
data.description: <p>Thailand wants to position itself as a global food powerhouse, yet local producers are being squeezed by imported produce and questions remain over whether the country is adequately protecting both farmers and consumers.</p>

data.title: Zuckerberg, Musk make plea at G20 for more AI data centers
data.description: CHAPEL HILL (UNITED STATES) - Mark Zuckerberg and Elon Musk on Tuesday stressed the need for more AI data centers and the electric power needed to support them at a meeting of G20 technology ministers focused on the disruptions and opportunity brought by artificial intelligence.

data.title: Canadian minister says Russia's G20 presence sparked 'discomfort'
data.description: ASHEVILLE (UNITED STATES) - Canadian Finance Minister Francois-Philippe Champagne said Tuesday that his Russian counterpart's presence at US-hosted G20 talks has caused unease among participants, given the suffering of Ukraine since Moscow's 2022 invasion.

data.title: US defends Trump's Venezuela oil deal
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - US officials on Tuesday defended President Donald Trump's oil deal with Venezuela, saying it would lower oil prices for Americans and counter Russian and Chinese influence on Washington's doorstep.

data.title: Norway's King Haakon VIII swears allegiance to constitution
data.description: OSLO - Norway's King Haakon VIII took an oath before parliament on Tuesday, the first major institutional step of his reign, though his wife, still convalescing after a lung transplant, was unable to attend.

data.title: Back-to-school in Cuba a grim day with shortages of everything
data.description: HAVANA - Cuban children began the new school year Tuesday with shortages of teachers, food and uniforms -- and often no electricity -- as the island endures a crippling US pressure campaign.

data.title: Syria site infrastructure 'consistent with nuclear reactor': IAEA
data.description: VIENNA - A Syrian site held infrastructure "consistent with a nuclear reactor", the UN nuclear watchdog said in a confidential report seen by AFP on Tuesday, adding that the country under ousted former leader Bashar al-Assad "failed to report nuclear material, facilities and activities".

data.title: Nepali families hold symbolic funerals for the missing
data.description: KATHMANDU - After days of searching shelters and morgues, many Nepali families held symbolic funeral ceremonies on Tuesday to “liberate the souls” of loved ones missing since the deadly flash floods last week.

data.title: Galliano pulls Met exhibit after antisemitism backlash
data.description: The fashion designer John Galliano has agreed to cancel a planned exhibition of his work that was to kick off New York’s fabled Met Gala in 2027, following criticism from donors and political leaders over his past antisemitic remarks.

data.title: Man arrested with 880,000 speed pills at Isan resort
data.description: SAKON NAKHON - A man arrested with 880,000 methamphetamine pills at a resort in Waritchaphum district in this northeastern province has confessed to trafficking the narcotics from Laos, authorities said on Tuesday.

data.title: Cabinet approves double-track rail expansion
data.description: The cabinet has approved six railway projects under the second phase of double-track expansion, with three southern line projects receiving full funding worth 106.7 billion baht.

data.title: Home tele-rehab system completes Thai trials
data.description: Chulalongkorn University researchers have completed trials of an AI and augmented reality rehabilitation system that lets patients with balance disorders train at home under remote specialist monitoring.

data.title: Health coverage law changes face backlash
data.description: Civil society groups have come out against proposed changes to the universal healthcare law, warning the amendments could erode rights to public health coverage.

data.title: China’s Xi visits Egypt as US sanctions threat looms
data.description: BEIJING - Chinese President Xi Jinping is set to arrive in Egypt on Tuesday, making a rare trip to the Middle East as both countries face the threat of US sanctions over financial links to Iran.

data.title: Premier League clubs chase last-minute transfer deals
data.description: LONDON - Manchester City hope to seal a blockbuster move for Enzo Fernandez, while Arsenal have their sights set on Julian Alvarez in the final hours before the transfer window closes.

data.title: New body to turn education research into policy
data.description: The problems with reforming education may lie less in a lack of research, funding or expertise than in a failure to get evidence into policy and the classroom, the Equitable Education Fund (EEF) says.

data.title: Betagro Launches THB 50M Campaign to Promote BQM 24/7 Quality Nationwide
data.description: Bangkok–September 1, 2026–BetagroPublic Company Limited(BTG), a leading integrated food company in Thailand ,has launched its new“Betagro, Sure Food.Good Taste.”campaignfor itsBetagro-branded products.This initiative underscoresBetagro’scommitment to quality and safety,emphasizing‘thedeliciousness you can trust’through itsBQM24/7qualitystandards, whichspan from animal farming to food production,ultimately buildingconsumerconfidence.
